widgets_values:
Using the attached character as the subject, generate a continuous cycling sequence where the environment transitions seamlessly. Medium profile tracking shot, locked 50mm focal length, steady steadicam pace matching the subject's ride. The same cute amigurumi-style character — green crochet/knit textured body, round face with dot eyes and pink blush, small head nubs, mint-green bicycle with black seat and handlebars, front basket with two yellow bells — pedals left to right at a calm, steady cadence. Identical character design, bicycle shape, yarn-like surface detail, proportions, and pedaling motion throughout; no morphing, no redesign, no wardrobe change.

Starting in a soft pale mint-green infinity studio matching the reference, the environment morphs seamlessly through three biomes in one continuous shot: burnt-orange desert dunes at golden hour, a neon-soaked rainy city street with reflections in wet pavement, then a misty alpine pine forest with soft fog and cool diffused light. Each transition flows without hard cuts — studio floor becomes sand, sand becomes asphalt, rain mist becomes forest air — while the character and bike remain visually unchanged, like a toy brought through different dream worlds.

Stylized photorealistic 3D render, toy-core / amigurumi aesthetic, soft diffused lighting, gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, whimsical yet cinematic
